A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 24-page versions of the same GAIN-RL paper, including Appendices A–G. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison. Inconsistent revised captions are reporting issues rather than missing evidence.

before.justification: v1 reports original mathematical-reasoning and coding experiments, training-efficiency comparisons, ablations, and analyses of model representations, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and results and includes revised appendix matrix visualizations. Results retained from v1 still constitute original empirical evidence.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same angle-based data ordering, Gaussian sampling, and accuracy/angle-based sampling-mean update. The redesigned Figure 1 does not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: DeepScaleR and DeepCoder training, the six mathematics and three coding evaluation benchmarks, and the single-task studies remain unchanged. The appendix revisions concern diagnostic models and matrix products, not new datasets or task coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain GRPO, ADARFT, and PPO, including the same ADARFT exclusions for coding and GSM8K. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Figures 11–13 change the reported diagnostic model from LLaVA-1.5-7B to Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and display 24 rather than 32 layers. Main training and evaluation settings remain unchanged. Figure 14's model-label change alone does not establish that its experiment was rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix B.1 revises the empirical check of approximate weight orthogonality: Figures 11–13 replace query–key, down-projection, and value-projection products with down-, output-, and up-projection self-products. The existing component ablations, batch-size sensitivity study, weighted-signal analysis, and other diagnostic plots are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or changes repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Benchmark results retain the same reporting practice without uncertainty estimates across training runs.

E6.justification: Figures 11–13 contain replacement matrix heatmaps with different plotted values and scales under changed model/projection settings; these are revised diagnostic results, not same-setting performance gains. Tables 1–5 and the benchmark learning curves are unchanged. Figure 14 retains the same plotted data despite its revised model caption.

T1.justification: Equation (4) changes x_i x_j^T to x_i^T x_j, locally correcting the scalar inner-product term in the gradient-norm expansion. The formal assumptions, four appendix theoretical insights, and substantive remaining derivations are retained; the attention-subscript edits in Equations (18)–(19) are notation cleanup.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about angle concentration, model-informed scheduling, training acceleration, and improved data efficiency. The scope of the claimed contributions is unchanged.

C2.justification: The gradient-, attention-, and neuron-based explanations remain the same, as do interpretations of the experiments and the discussion of signal weighting and future applications. No substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1, Appendix E's implementation and training configuration, hardware information, and the code-access statement are retained. The revised diagnostic model settings do not come with additional reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: The bibliography and Appendix A's related-work discussion are unchanged. The positioning against existing data-selection and curriculum methods, including the claimed novelty of intrinsic model signals, is retained.

P1.justification: Editorial changes are localized, including Section 3's cross-reference from Appendix F.1 to Appendix F, attention-index cleanup, and the updated version header. The prose, narrative sequence, and organization of the main sections and appendices remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redesigned with a different flow layout and stage labels. Figures 11–13 use new 24-layer grids, and Figure 14's caption changes, with some accompanying page reflow. Table structures and the remaining graphical content are retained.

improvement.justification: The redesigned overview and local equation correction offer modest benefits, but v2 introduces inconsistencies in the evidence supporting its theory. Appendix B.1 still describes the old matrix products although Figures 11–13 show different ones. Figure 14 relabels an unchanged 32-layer scatterplot as Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, whereas the neighboring Qwen heatmaps show 24 layers. These inconsistencies weaken the traceability of the supporting evidence; the central method and benchmark results remain unchanged.
